scope: Read-only code and saved public aggregate/metadata review; prospective recommendation only. No implementation or pipeline mutation.
main_finding_KO: 공간정보가 없는 것이 아니라, 고정 위치별 관계가 소수 요약벡터로 압축되어 있다. 순서보존 stencil은 시험할 가치가 있지만, TRAIN100%와 VAL 격차는 feature 불충분의 증명이 아니다.

existing_contract.C17_input: Exact C11 frozen DINOv2 ViT-S/14-reg4 T/Q/F/C/P384 plus8 scalars=1928; raw0; no expected-part/native-slot/r/uncertainty input.
existing_contract.P: Mean RAW final-layer full96-view16x16 tokens [7:9,7:9], THEN one L2 normalization. Token order is explicitly averaged, although positional/global information may remain inside token values.
existing_contract.Q: RAW context token bilinear sample at nativeq, index16*u-.5 / align_corners=False / border, THEN L2; Qoutside zeros Q/flag without adding inputU.
existing_contract.F_C: Full96 CLS and literal central32 CLS, each view resized224 with exact C8 valid-meanfill/bilinear-antialias normalization.
existing_contract.head: 1928 + abs(T-C),T*C,abs(Q-P),Q*P =3464; Linear64/ReLU/Linear1;221825 parameters.
existing_contract.V101: Already used copied trainable RGB CNN on literal central32, query feature at15.5/8=1.9375 on4x4 (alignTrue grid7/24), with frozen C1 scalar prior. It was a different representation/prior/contract, not a test of this DINO stencil.
existing_contract.earlier_spatial_inputs: V94 already had q-conditioned9x9 attention and positional offsets; a single q token/central crop is not a novel missing component.
existing_contract.global_receptive_field: Official attention uses all-token self-attention with no local mask; positional embeddings enter before transformer blocks. Ordered final patch tokens are not isolated pixel/ownership measurements.

C17_C18_fixed1000_control.interpretation: Oldloss1→0 had small mixed effects under this exact1000-step control; it does not exclude every optimization/interference mechanism.

capacity_probe.solver: Separate TRAIN-only full-batch LBFGS diagnostic;52 closures, not the matched AdamW control.
capacity_probe.interpretation: 795/795 available TRAIN fit shows these finite TRAIN labels are representable by this head on these cached features. It proves neither transfer sufficiency nor feature insufficiency; high VAL BCE despite errors is compatible with overconfident development-domain failure.

smallest_ordered_stencil_proposal.status: Prospective only, not implemented or admitted.
smallest_ordered_stencil_proposal.reuse: Keep all original1928 features byte-exact. Existing P supplies the centre node; append only8 outer384-D vectors, avoiding a duplicate centre descriptor.
smallest_ordered_stencil_proposal.nodes: Same full96 raw16x16 patch grid; bilinear samples at x,y token indices(3.5,7.5,11.5), row-major. These are q-relative {-L/4,0,+L/4}; grid coordinates{-0.5,0,+0.5} with align_corners=False. This is a spaced sampled3x3, NOT a contiguous3x3 token block.
smallest_ordered_stencil_proposal.normalization: Sample RAW, then L2 each outer descriptor. Retain cached P unchanged; mathematically centre7.5 equals raw2x2 average, but any finite-precision replay discrepancy must be recorded rather than silently relaxing parity.
smallest_ordered_stencil_proposal.dimension_if_appended_to_unchanged_head: 1928+8*384=5000 feature inputs; retain old derived1536 relations =>6536 linear inputs. Width64 gives418433 parameters (221825+196608). This is a capacity change and must be controlled.
smallest_ordered_stencil_proposal.availability: Keep original factual/context/model availability and safeU. Mean-filled invalid crop regions are not semanticE. Declare any node support treatment before extraction and use it identically in comparison arms.
smallest_ordered_stencil_proposal.needed_future_work: Raw token grids are not recoverable from the saved1928 vectors. An independently authorized same-RGB96 encoder replay would be needed; none is performed here.

minimal_matched_source_test.purpose: Compare access to spatially separated descriptors versus pooling, not prove pure ordering or causal pixel grounding.
minimal_matched_source_test.scope: Small first diagnostic can use the existing V125 wide source packet: all4896 rows retained,795 known+available TRAIN for loss, existing LOCO_VAL and TOMIE_DEVELOPMENT separately. Fixed1000 primary comparison; no new heldout claim or current test.
arms: POOL9: pool the SAME nine raw sampled nodes then L2; repeat that descriptor into8 extra positions while retaining cached originalP.
ORDERED: put8 outer node descriptors in fixed row-major positions, retaining cached originalP as centre.
minimal_matched_source_test.matched: Same original1928 features, shared nine-node extraction, same extended head parameter count/initialization, one predeclared existing source optimization/sampler recipe, same exact samples/weights/budget/raw0. Warmstart/additional-weight initialization and any secondary selection must be frozen before extraction; do not choose them from VAL results.
minimal_matched_source_test.interpretation_limit: These arms match sampled coverage and parameter count but change retained individual-token information and normalization/aggregation as well as explicit ordering. A win supports this representation package, not pure ordering alone. A fixed permutation is NOT an order-removal control because the head can learn its inverse.
minimal_matched_source_test.report: TRAIN fitting, all-planned versus available denominators, E-qOUT and SHAM-D-qIN by originalfold, cue/frame clusters, oldsource regressions only where a genuinely comparable descriptor input exists. Never infer new-method old18-cohort scores by silently zero-filling unextracted old stencil features.

remaining_ambiguities: Labels refer to an existing weak structural-cue region/component, not target material or visibility of the literal q pixel. q-alpha outside E and q-alpha inside SHAM D are intentional.

No expected-cue identity, signed q-to-reference displacement or physical part identity enters the head. Multiple visible pallet structures/instances can leave which cue is expected ambiguous even with an ordered grid.
Native q error, target association, target-self occlusion and external occlusion are distinct. Geometry-S route remains separate; a stencil adds no verified association or new coordinate output.
Final DINO tokens retain global context; improved stencil results would not show that decisions use only pixels under q or establish target ownership.

limits: TRAIN is6cues/3originalLOCO RGBs; offsets/ranks/variants are repeated derivatives, not795 independent originals.
VALIDATION is26cues/6originalRGBs:2LOCO frames plus4TOMIE frames from one episode; allTOMIE remains development-only VALIDATION.
The same sources/folds have been inspected and used repeatedly. Crop-level random resplitting would leak scene/cue/donor/composition identity.
Fixed pasted shapes, scale/lighting/alpha edges and donor/material appearance can be shortcuts; preserving cue uncertainty does not make composites natural foreign-occlusion gold.
A new representation alone does not increase independently localized real cue/instance/occluder diversity. A frozen genuinely new capture-group evaluation is needed before a transfer claim.
